name: ctpa_acute_pe_rv_strain
clinical_history: 58M, sudden onset pleuritic chest pain and dyspnoea, SpO2 91% on air, HR 112, D-dimer 4.2, Wells score 6. Query PE.
findings:
- Filling defects right main pulmonary artery extending into lower lobe segmental branches
- Further filling defect left lower lobe segmental artery
- RV:LV ratio 1.2, interventricular septal flattening
- Small right pleural effusion
- Mosaic attenuation right lower lobe, no consolidation
- No pericardial effusion
- Incidental 5mm right upper lobe pulmonary nodule
- Thyroid and imaged upper abdomen unremarkable

name: mri_lumbar_disc_extrusion
clinical_history: 34F, 6 weeks left leg pain radiating to sole of foot, weak plantarflexion, failed conservative management. Query disc prolapse.
findings:
- L5/S1 left paracentral disc extrusion with inferior migration
- Extrusion compresses left S1 nerve root in lateral recess
- Moderate narrowing left lateral recess, central canal preserved
- L4/5 mild disc bulge, no root compression
- Facet joints unremarkable
- Conus normal, terminates T12/L1
- Vertebral heights preserved, no marrow lesion

name: us_abdomen_gallstones
clinical_history: 42F, recurrent RUQ pain after meals, ALP 180, bilirubin 24. Query gallstones.
findings:
- Multiple mobile gallstones, largest 14mm
- Gallbladder wall 2mm, no pericholecystic fluid
- Negative sonographic Murphy's
- CBD 5mm, no ductal stone seen
- No intrahepatic duct dilatation
- Liver normal echotexture, no focal lesion
- Pancreatic head visualised and normal, body and tail obscured by bowel gas
- Kidneys normal, no hydronephrosis
- Spleen normal
- No free fluid

name: ct_head_acute_on_chronic_sdh
clinical_history: 81M on apixaban, fall 3 days ago, increasing confusion, GCS 13. Query intracranial haemorrhage.
findings:
- Left frontoparietal subdural collection, mixed density, maximum depth 18mm
- 7mm midline shift to the right
- Effacement of left lateral ventricle
- Basal cisterns patent, no uncal herniation
- No subarachnoid or intraparenchymal haemorrhage
- Chronic small vessel ischaemic change
- No skull fracture

name: ct_ap_diverticulitis_abscess
clinical_history: 66F, 4 days left iliac fossa pain, fever 38.2, WCC 15, CRP 180. Query diverticulitis.
findings:
- Sigmoid diverticulosis with segmental wall thickening over 6cm
- Pericolic fat stranding
- 3.2cm rim-enhancing pericolic collection adjacent to sigmoid
- No free intraperitoneal gas
- Trace pelvic free fluid only
- Ureters not obstructed
- Liver, spleen, pancreas, adrenals, kidneys unremarkable
- No suspicious osseous lesion
